result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a couple of visible viewport and layering issues that make content appear clipped or obscured.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar overlaps the second restaurant card, leaving its image and likely content partially hidden behind the navigation area.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content, or ensure the page can scroll far enough that every card clears the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The category chip row and the fastest-restaurant carousel are visibly cut off at the right edge, showing only partial items without an obvious scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Keep the horizontal carousel behavior but add a subtle fade, partial next-item treatment, or another visual cue indicating that the rows are horizontally scrollable.
